title: Semantic Gravity Wells: Why Negative Constraints Backfire
abstract: arXiv:2601.08070v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Negative constraints (instructions of the form "do not use word X") represent a fundamental test of instruction-following capability in large language models. Despite their apparent simplicity, these constraints fail with striking regularity, and the conditions governing failure have remained poorly understood. This paper presents a mechanistic investigation of negative instruction failure in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. We introduce semantic pressure, a quantitative measure of the model's intrinsic probability of generating the forbidden word, and show that violation probability rises with pressure ($p = \sigma(-2.95 + 2.76 P_0)$; $n=40{,}000$ samples from 2,500 prompts; prompt-bootstrap 95% CI for slope: [2.53, 3.01]), from 5% of samples at low pressure to 44% at high pressure. translated_title: 语义引力井：为什么负面约束会适得其反
translated_abstract: 负面约束（即“不要使用词X”形式的指令）是对大语言模型指令遵循能力的一项基础性考验。尽管这类约束看似简单，却以惊人的规律性失败，而其失败条件至今仍缺乏充分理解。本文对Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型中负面指令失效问题进行了机制层面的研究。我们提出了“语义压力”这一量化指标，用以衡量模型生成被禁用词的内在概率，并证明违规概率随压力上升（p = σ(-2.95 + 2.76 P₀)；基于2,500条提示词的40,000个样本；斜率的提示词自助法95%置信区间为[2.53, 3.01]），违规率从低压力时的5%上升到高压力时的44%。在对比相同压力水平的提示词时，我们发现失败案例中负面指令所诱导的抑制效果要弱得多：在相同压力区间内，该指令……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“语义压力”这一量化指标，通过机制分析揭示大语言模型违背负面指令的概率随其生成被禁词的内在倾向呈Logistic关系上升（从5%升至44%），失败的原因在于指令诱导的抑制被模型内在生成倾向所压倒。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "semantic pressure," a quantitative measure of a model's intrinsic tendency to generate a forbidden word, and mechanistically shows that negative-constraint violations rise logistically with pressure (from 5% to 44%), revealing that failures occur when instruction-induced suppression is overwhelmed by the model's inherent generation propensity.
